notes: Fixed the app closing right after opening on some devices.
The floating pen now disables itself safely if your device can't run it — it can never crash the app.
You can turn the floating pen on/off in Settings.
If the web content ever stops responding, the app reloads it instead of going blank.
More detailed crash diagnostics, including web errors, in Settings → Troubleshooting.
Android downloads use versioned file names, so you always get the newest APK.
